messages.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
messages.text: Morning all :sunny: Summer flight is live. All 10 paid campaigns are delivering across US/UK/DE/JP/BR/FR on both platforms. Budgets are loaded at the June plan (~$51k/day blended). Please keep changes under 20%/day per campaign for the first week so the networks can settle.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Meta + TikTok confirmed live. meta_aeo_purchase_t1 is still in learning on iOS, expect wobbly CPIs until ~50 purchase events.

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Google, AppLovin and Unity all spending. uac_tcpa_payers started a bit slow, I raised the tCPA by 10% to get it out of the gate.

replies.author: Oscar Lindqvist
replies.text: I set up the daily pacing sheet, it pulls yesterday's spend by channel at 07:00 UTC. Shout if a column looks off.
